sentences.text: Dr.D.V.Chalapathi, vs The State Of Telangana on 12 March, 2025

Author: N.Tukaramji
Bench: N.Tukaramji
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.Tukaramji
 Criminal Petition No. 3594 Of 2025
Order

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS, 2023') seeking quashment of the proceedings in Crime No. 81 of 2024 of EOW Cyb (Cyberabad) Police Station, Cyberabad Commissionerate, against the petitioner/accused No.3.
2.

entities.text: EOW Cyb (Cyberabad) Police Station, Cyberabad Commissionerate
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The petitioner is arrayed as accused No.3 in Crime No.81 of 2024 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

3. Heard Mr.C.Hari Preeth, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent No.1-State.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that though the petitioner is determined to see the process through and the alleged offences are punishable with an imprisonment upto seven years,
the Police concerned has not issued any notice under Section 35 (3) of BNSS, 2023, as such the petitioner is apprehending coercive measures against him.
He further submits as the petitioner is ready to cooperate 2 NTR,J with the investigation, hence prayed for necessary directions for issuance of notice as per law.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the Police concerned are ready to issue 35 (3)
of BNSS, 2023 notice.
6. I have perused the materials on record.

7. Having regard to the fact that the alleged offences are punishable with an imprisonment upto seven years and as the petitioner/accused No.3 is ready to engage himself in the process, the Investigating Officer concerned is directed to issue notice under Section 35 (3) of BNSS, 2023 against the petitioner/accused No.3 and conduct proceedings as per the guidelines of Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. With this direction, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
